title: Among female superheroes published by Marvel Comics with height between 160
question: Among female superheroes published by Marvel Comics with height between 160 and 185 cm, find those whose eye and hair colors are the same. For each such color, report the count of superheroes and rank them by popularity (most common first).

prediction.sql: SELECT c."XCL_006" AS color, COUNT(s."XCL_018") AS superhero_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(s."XCL_018") DESC) AS popularity_rank FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014" INNER JOIN gender AS g ON s."XCL_021" = g."XCL_007" INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s."XCL_022" = c."XCL_005" WHERE p."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics' AND g."XCL_008" = 'Female' AND s."XCL_028" BETWEEN 160 AND 185 AND s."XCL_022" = s."XCL_023" GROUP BY c."XCL_006" ORDER BY superhero_count DESC

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT c."XCL_006" AS EyeColor, COUNT(s."XCL_018") AS SuperheroCount
FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN gender AS g ON s."XCL_021" = g."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s."XCL_022" = c."XCL_005"
WHERE p."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND g."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND s."XCL_028" BETWEEN 160 AND 185
  AND s."XCL_023" = s."XCL_022"
GROUP BY c."XCL_006"
ORDER BY SuperheroCount DESC
